purpose: Canonical sensitivity-floor provenance closing DeepSeek-M1 from the 13th real cross-vendor R-round on P4 v1.0.63.
produced_by: On-disk arithmetic from Sec.~IX.B Eq.~13 (Fisher half-modulation derivation) + factor-of-2 convention propagation; emitted by hand 2026-05-14 to satisfy real-vendor provenance demand.

conventions.A_dipole_definition: full-amplitude dipole modulation parameter A in p_CW(hat_n) = (1/2)(1 + A cos(theta))

empirical_floor.sample_label: HC-spiral (equivariant probability > 0.9 for either CW or CCW)
empirical_floor.empirical_floor_strict_inequality_reason: the 50% recovery at 3-sigma threshold is bounded only above by the highest tested amplitude A=0.5% which gives P(sigma>2)=0.18 (i.e. < 0.5); a primordial half-modulation at the empirical-floor amplitude would produce P(sigma>2) >~ 0.5, so the strict inequality > 0.5% is conservative

summary_for_paper: The headline empirical sensitivity floor |A_dipole| > 0.5% is derived from the Wave 14-NN injection-recovery study on the HC-spiral subsample (N=471,049, f_sky=0.4240); the strict inequality reflects the bound that 50% recovery at 3-sigma threshold lies above 0.5% within the tested A in [0.05, 0.50]% grid (companion JSON wave_14_nn_injection_recovery.json records all per-amplitude P(sigma>2) and P(sigma>3) values). The Fisher statistical floor |A_dipole| ~ 0.29% (ideal full-amplitude) / ~0.4% (conservative full-amplitude) / ~0.2% (conservative half-modulation A/2) follows from the Fisher arithmetic on the full Catalog C (N_spiral=3,201,160) at 50/50 balance under p_CW = (1/2)(1 + A cos theta).
